pokedexEntries.ru: CRADILY roams around the ocean floor in search of food. This POKéMON freely extends its tree trunk-like neck and captures unwary prey using its eight tentacles.

pokedexEntries.sa: CRADILY’s body serves as an anchor, preventing it from being washed away in rough seas. This POKéMON secretes a strong digestive fluid from its tentacles.

pokedexEntries.frlg: It ensnares prey with its eight tentacles. It then melts the prey with a strong acid before feeding.

pokedexEntries.em: It drags its heavy body along the seafloor. It makes its nest in the shallows of warm seas. CRADILY can be seen on beaches when the tide goes out.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It lives in warm seas. Its heavy body weighs it down so it won’t get washed away in rough weather.

pokedexEntries.bw: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.

pokedexEntries.x: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.

pokedexEntries.y: It ensnares prey with its eight tentacles. It then melts the prey with a strong acid before feeding.

pokedexEntries.or: Cradily roams around the ocean floor in search of food. This Pokémon freely extends its tree trunk-like neck and captures unwary prey using its eight tentacles.

pokedexEntries.as: Cradily’s body serves as an anchor, preventing it from being washed away in rough seas. This Pokémon secretes a strong digestive fluid from its tentacles.

pokedexEntries.us: Normally, it lived on shallow sea shoals. When the tide went out, this Pokémon came up on land to search for prey.

pokedexEntries.um: This carnivorous Pokémon lived in primordial seas. It catches prey in its eight tentacles and dissolves them with digestive fluid as it eats.

pokedexEntries.sw: It has short legs and can’t walk very fast, but its neck and tentacles can extend to over three times their usual length to nab distant prey.

pokedexEntries.sh: Once Cradily catches prey in its tentacles, it digests them whole and absorbs their nutrients.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.
